component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Creates a bar plot visualizing the number of valid values in all selected columns.
Columns can be grouped by sample type based on experimental design. Columns of the same sample type can be summarized using mean or median functions, or just visualized separately using with the same fill color if no summarization function is selected. It is also possible to show error bars (SD in case of mean summarization function, IQR in case of median).
Statistical comparison between samples can be performed, parametric or non-parametric option needs to be chosen based on value distribution and sample size. For comparison between two sample groups, t-test or Mann-Whitney U test will be used. More than two sample groups will be first compared using ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis test and in case of a significant result, pairwise comparisons using post-hoc TukeyHSD or Dunn's test will be performed. Sample design needs to be specified to be able to perform statistical comparison.
